item.title: California Tiki Night | Study Hall — Tue Aug 11, 6:30 PM — Conway Social Club
item.description:
Escape to the golden age of tropical cocktails at our California Tiki Study Hall. Join us in The Conway Room for an evening dedicated to the history, craftsmanship, and enduring influence of tiki culture on the cocktail world. This immersive experience explores the pioneers who defined the movement—including Trader Vic and Don the Beachcomber—and how their creativity transformed rum cocktails into an American classic.
Throughout the evening, you’ll discover the foundations of tiki mixology while tasting a curated lineup of rum-forward cocktails featuring tropical juices, fresh citrus, house-made syrups, and island-inspired flavors. Along the way, you’ll learn the techniques, ingredients, and balance that make tiki drinks some of the most complex and celebrated cocktails ever created. As with every Study Hall, you’ll step behind the bar to build a cocktail of your own under the guidance of our team. item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Fri Jul 31, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

Community, Storytime, Babies, Toddlers, Children
September is Library Card Sign-Up Month! The Library will now be allowing children to have their own Library Card! Kier and Helen will be in the Story Room to help with sign-ups. You will have and be able to use your Library Card the same day! Ages 0-5.
Source: Lancaster Libraries

item.title: Anti-Fascist Craft Night in Lititz with the Warwick Democrats! — Wed Oct 7, 3:00 PM — Lititz
item.description:
We love democracy. We love crafts. We love snacks. And we love civic engagement. You too? Join us for **Anti-Fascist Craft Night** in Lititz—a low-key hang where we cut up cereal boxes and old magazines, make wild collage postcards and letters, and send our thoughts (and shade) to our elected officials. Make your voice heard in a weirdly therapeutic and hands-on way! **What to bring:** * Clean cardboard (cereal/snack boxes) or card stock * Old magazines, catalogs, newspapers, greeting cards, etc
Source: Lancaster County Dems (Mobilize)

item.title: Elizabethtown Dems Monthly Meeting — Thu Oct 8, 3:30 PM — Elizabethtown
item.description:
Join the Elizabethtown Democratic Committee for our monthly meeting. We welcome anyone interested in making ETown a welcoming place for all.
Source: Lancaster County Dems (Mobilize)

item.title: Read to Me! — Tue Oct 13, 4:30 PM — Ephrata
item.description:
Community, Storytime, Babies, Toddlers, Children
Parents and caregivers will be encouraged to read aloud a short story for the children, each family getting to take a turn! If you are worried about preparing your reading voice, remember you are your child’s first example of language-they believe in you (and we do, too!). Ages 0-5.
Source: Lancaster Libraries
